name: tested-feature
description: Plan, implement, keep the tests green, review with fresh eyes.

steps.prompt:
Read the codebase and write a short implementation plan for this feature to PLAN.md: {{feature}}
Do not change any code yet. Do not ask questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them in PLAN.md.
Run the test suite and fix everything that fails.
Review the diff of this work with fresh eyes: bugs, missing edge cases, leftover debug code. Fix what you find.

Write a concise CHANGELOG entry for {{feature}}. Notes from the review:

{{prev.output}}
